meta.protocol: benchmarks/holdout/sample.py (seed 20261026): R = 12 random repos x 10 random functions; M = up to 5 marker-text functions per repo, 60 in all
meta.population: files picked by the product's discovery in 35 public repositories never named in the detector's benchmarks, tests, docs, changelog, internal notes or memory
meta.labeler: rule author (Claude), blind: labels fixed and committed before the detector ran on these repositories
meta.display: functions <= 80 lines read in full; longer ones from signature, first 20 and last 15 lines, every return/raise/except/yield line, and parameter names absent from the body text

rules.hollow: the body does not do what its name, docstring or signature promises; class names follow benchmarks/recall/labels.json
rules.GENUINE includes: abstract/protocol/interface methods, fixed signatures (framework callbacks, dependency injection, CLI subcommand signatures), documented intentional no-ops and fixtures, test doubles, and handlers that log the failure and return an empty/neutral value
rules.FAILURE_AS_SUCCESS: a failure path that returns fabricated or success-shaped data (not an empty/neutral value)

classes.STUB_DISGUISED: returns a constant or its input; only cosmetic statements (logging) around it
classes.FAILURE_AS_SUCCESS: an exception handler reports success or a benign result instead of the failure
classes.CLAIM_WITHOUT_MECHANISM: the docstring promises a mechanism (retry, cache, parallel, pagination, weighting, filtering) the body does not have
classes.IGNORED_INPUT: a parameter the contract depends on is never used
classes.ALWAYS_PASS_CHECK: a check, validator or authorization that passes regardless of its input
classes.HARDCODED_RESULT: returns canned data where the docstring promises computed or fetched data
classes.PLACEHOLDER_PLAIN: an obvious stub: pass, ..., NotImplementedError or a TODO with a default return
